title: Astrid and the Will
author: Lena Quintana
blurb: Edmund Okonkwo, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
